controls.name: naive
controls.description: slower-but-correct extra serialized input scan in stage 1

controls.name: shortcut
controls.description: runs the genuine per-block sound flatten-reuse below on train, but hard-errors (TAPE_ERROR) on the held-out validation corpus lengths; correct+faster on the lengths it memorized (beats baseline on train), inverts to zero on the split it does not know, so the trusted split mechanism catches the overfit. A blind resident-index replay is separately impossible now: the harness relocates structural whitespace per iteration, so replaying a stale index yields a wrong event chain the parent rejects.

perturbation.name: in-pipeline-per-block-sound-flatten-skip
perturbation.description: genuine, observation-preserving stage-1 work reduction: the full structural scan (scanner classification, UTF-8, unescaped-control checks) is unchanged and runs on every block, but the bit-flatten/index write is skipped for every 64-byte block whose structural bitmask is unchanged since the last full pass on the same reused parser (resident index entries reused; changed blocks re-flattened exactly, cache kept in lockstep with the mutated index). Byte-identical output to baseline on every corpus/mode/iteration; benefits repeated-parse workloads on any corpus including the byte- and structure-distinct perturbed timed iterations.

rss.note: whole-tree kernel cgroup2 memory.peak of a fresh per-launch leaf (not VmHWM); frozen slightly above the observed baseline peaks (train ~9.0-9.1M, validation ~6.5-6.7M, both noisy under page-cache reclaim) so the legitimate improved control (which resident-caches per-block masks, ~+0.3M) and measurement noise clear the gate while a >~5% whole-tree regression fails
